source: Drone 1 as one plant for every configuration since the pivots were raised (2026-11-11 on), the bands' preload, the thrust table and the ESCs' motor lag the only per-configuration terms (sw/sim/scorecard_flights.json; motor_tau under configurations for the old ESCs), the physics in physical form (william/plant, models/NOTES.md 'One plant'): the rotors' in-plane force at their hubs (rotor_drag_h, from the body's velocity, rates and the assemblies' swing) acting flap_lever up the shaft, their axial inflow (rotor_inflow) of which a steady climb keeps inflow_steady once the motor has sped up (inflow_recovery), the tilt's pitch authority 1.57 times the CAD geometry's (tilt_authority: the CoM lower or the pitch inertia smaller than the CAD estimate, not measured), the servos' dead time (left 75 ms, right 55 ms from the logged command) and an underdamped loop (wn 33 rad/s, zeta 0.22), and a disturbance state (observer: an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck torque, correlation 26 s, estimated from the log in the scorecard's predictions); no attitude pendulum, no lagged tilt (pitch_wake), no constant pushes (each flight's CoM is its own), no clipped or faded speed terms (rotor_drag [0, 0]: the hubs' force is the drag). Fitted by sw/sim/fit_plant.py (CMA-ES) on 56 flights (scorecard_flights.json training 'airframe_2026-11-15_plant') on the scorecard's total, the frequency response of servo command to pitch rate each configuration's hovers measure (sw/sim/plant_response.py, weight 5) and four hovers flown closed loop by the firmware's C (2026-11-15 06:32 and 06:30, 04:12, 2026-11-12 01:07; weight 0.5); held out: every burst and flip, the 06:53 and 11-11 23:07 divergences, the 06:50 doublet, the 06:58 and 07:12 hovers, the 01:55 and 01:59 ladders, the boat's 00:4x hovers, 05:18 and 05:28. rotor_momentum is the fit's 0.0028, a fifth of the props' own (about 0.014): with 0.014 the hovers predict worse open loop (0.984 / 0.895 against 0.959 / 0.882) and the 07:13 burst30 fails in the sim where the drone flew it; unresolved (models/NOTES.md).
